title: 100% claude code - Sinterklaas / Dutch Santa Claus
author: DearObjective4053
selftext:
In our country we have "Sinterklaas", the dutch version of Santa Claus basically.

I asked Claude to create his mansion > fully with Javascript drawings. It had to be able to load in browsers and phones.

It has this puzzle game where in it you need to find it's 12 hidden stickers and besides from that a story you can watch.

Claude did the illustrations, animation, music. Voices are from Elevenlabs.

Sorry it's Dutch, but still hopefully cool to share :)

Feel free to ask me anything about my process!
